newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan to sell July diesel below Singapore prices.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to sell July diesel below Singapore prices.

text.p: Taiwan state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) is expected to award a tender to sell 225,000-250,000 barrel of gas oil at below Singapore spot quotes on a free-on-board (fob) basis, a CPC source said on Friday.
"We are going to award the cargo at below Singapore prices. We are not sure if our customer will accept the terms of our sale yet," the source said.
The source said the award price was at more than a 10 cents discount to spot Singapore prices on fob Kaoshiung basis for July 23-27 lifting.
CPC chose to award the contract on a floating basis as the fixed price bids were below their expectations, the source said.
In its last tender, CPC sold two cargoes for July 2-18 lifting at $22.50-$23.00 per barrel, fob Kaohsiung basis.
